title: Zesty Smoky Kenyan Chicken Flatbread
description: Fluffy flatbread loaded with smoky marinated chicken, fajita seasoning, and fresh cilantro for a high-protein, light Kenyan-inspired lunch.
instructions: In a bowl combine chicken, fajita seasoning, smoked paprika, olive oil, lemon juice and half of the cilantro; marinate for 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl whisk flour, baking powder, salt and water until a smooth batter forms; let rest 5 minutes.
Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat; pour 2/3 cup of batter to form a round flatbread and cook 1-2 minutes per side until golden.
Remove flatbread, set aside, repeat with remaining batter to make two more flatbreads.
In the same skillet cook marinated chicken for 5-6 minutes until cooked through, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle mozzarella over the chicken, let melt for 1 minute, then remove from heat.
Assemble each flatbread by spreading chicken mixture, topping with remaining cilantro and optional chili flakes, then fold or roll.
Return assembled flatbreads to skillet for 1 minute to warm through and slightly crisp edges.
Slice into wedges, garnish with extra cilantro if desired, and serve hot.
